note: Global developmental delay and intellectual disability are consistently reported across all described cohorts of individuals with biallelic GTF3C3 variants.

evidence.text: In a comprehensive review of all published cases with biallelic GTF3C3 variants alongside a novel patient, global developmental delay and intellectual disability were identified as among the most consistent manifestations across the cohort.

source.title: Case report: Characterization of a patient with novel biallelic ...
source.quote: The most consistent manifestations across the cohort include global developmental delay, intellectual disability, epilepsy, central nervous system malformations, and additional neurological abnormalities.

evidence.text: Twelve affected individuals from seven unrelated families with homozygous or compound heterozygous missense variants in GTF3C3 presented with intellectual disability, motor impairments, and seizures.

source.title: Biallelic variants in GTF3C3 result in an autosomal recessive disorder with intellectual disability
source.quote: Twelve affected individuals from 7 unrelated families were identified with homozygous or compound heterozygous missense variants in GTF3C3... The cohort presented with intellectual disability, variable nonfamilial facial features, motor impairments, seizures, and cerebellar/corpus callosum malformations.
